coordinates: layout of the 12,586 pages, 0..1000 both axes

edges.note: directed, self-loops dropped; all 2,130 replay runs (incl. blank-page); traversals equals the edge count n of the layout graph

step1.definition: First hop from each of the 20 hub starts. Agents: step-1 valid link decisions, T=1 top_p=1 pool (the analysis notes of 9-11 Nov 2026 §1; grid e0/e2/e3 + t1_sweep, n=1341), per-model distributions averaged with equal model weight (agents) or pooled by decision (agents_pooled_decisions). Readers: Wikimedia clickstream (Sep 2026), listed clicks over the same step-1 menu (>= 50 clicks). top1/top3 = share of the 1st / top 3 links; entropy in bits; k80 = number of links needed to cover 80% of the mass.
caveats: Plug-in entropy and k80 are biased low at small n: agents have about 50-90 decisions per start, readers have hundreds to thousands of clicks. readers_at_agent_n re-draws the readers at the agents sample size (500 multinomial draws per start).
Readers only exist for the first click from each start (clickstream is page-to-page, not sessions).
Agents pool 8 models and several contexts; this is not a single population.

method_bundling.name: KDEEB-lite (kernel density edge bundling, after Hurter et al. 2012)
method_bundling.steps: Undirected pairs with >= 3 distinct runs in either direction. Each edge is a straight polyline sampled every ~20 units (4 to 24 segments), endpoints fixed. 20 iterations: splat all polyline points (weight sqrt(runs)) on a 250x250 grid over [0,1000], Gaussian-smooth (sigma 30 -> 8 units), move each interior point 2.5 units up the density gradient, then Laplacian-smooth the polyline (lambda 0.35). Deviation from the straight edge is capped at 0.3 x edge length; edges shorter than 40 units (about 68% of pairs) stay straight, because bundling them only inflates detours.

b_vs_B_consensus_content.note: G variant = grid e0/e2/e3 only, model-equal weights, as in the consensus-content analysis
